integrity: The proof is symbolic: it decomposes the cyclic subgroup graph of the generalized dihedral group, uses the published nilpotent comparison theorem for the kernel, and proves the remaining cyclic arithmetic inequality from the coprime product formula. Bounded enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to generalized dihedral groups with nontrivial odd abelian kernel.
It does not settle the cyclic-subgroup edge-minimality conjecture for arbitrary finite groups of even order.
An equivalent generalized-dihedral statement could exist in unindexed literature.
title: Cyclic-subgroup edge minimality for generalized dihedral groups
